subject: math

hotspots.label: Equal ratios
hotspots.description: Two ratios that stay equal as they scale — 2/4 = 4/8.
hotspots.positionHint: The equality plate between the two recipe cards.

hotspots.label: Missing value
hotspots.description: The unknown x in a proportion like 3/5 = x/10 — what the solver finds.
hotspots.positionHint: The blank slot on the right recipe card.
hotspots.function: The value a proportion is solved to find.

hotspots.label: Cross products
hotspots.description: Multiplying across the equals sign (a × d = b × c) is how proportions are checked and solved.
hotspots.positionHint: The diagonal lines linking numbers across the proportion plate.
hotspots.function: The multiplication test that solves and checks proportions.

visualStyleNotes: Fractions And Ratios, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. Two clean recipe cards on a mat with an equality plate between them and a servings slider. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Recipe cards: warm paper plates with ink text (people count + flour cups). Equality plate: warm paper with '2/4 = 4/8'. Servings slider: soft warm-grey rail with amber knob that scales both cards. Cross-product lines: thin ink-grey diagonal rods. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: proportions as scaling recipe cards — a people/flour pair that grows together while the ratio stays equal, plus a cross-product solver.

GEOMETRY: Two recipe cards (floating flat plates ~0.9 × 0.6) at x ≈ −0.75 and +0.75, y ≈ 0.35. Left card: '4 people · 2 cups'. Right card: '8 people · 4 cups'. Equality plate between them at top: '2/4 = 4/8'. Servings slider at the front rescales both cards (4/2, 8/4, 12/6...) keeping the ratio. A Cross-Product layer draws two diagonal rods across the equality plate and lights the pairings (2×8 and 4×4) when solving. Missing-value mode blanks the right card's number for a '3/5 = x/10' puzzle.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) recipe cards; (2) equality plate + cross-product rods; (3) missing-value puzzle.

CAMERA: head-on, slightly above, from +z frames both cards; labels legible. Budget 6-10k triangles. Named nodes: Card_Left, Card_Right, EqualityPlate, CrossRods, ServingsSlider, PuzzleSlot, ResultBadge. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
